invariant: Inv_NoResumeWithUnknownOutcome: Execution cannot resume while any mutating tool call outcome is unknown
preconditions: Local ExecutionEngine contains in-flight or crashed non-READ_ONLY tool call in STARTED or OUTCOME_UNKNOWN state; handoff.unresolvedSideEffects is empty
sequence: 1. Engine records tool start with NON_IDEMPOTENT_WRITE 2. Tool crashes or worker is interrupted before completion 3. Engine holds STARTED tool checkpoint 4. prepareResume called with handoff having empty unresolvedSideEffects 5. prepareResume only checks handoff.unresolvedSideEffects and marks execution 'ready' to resume
alloy_verdict: COUNTEREXAMPLE in mutant (SAT); UNSAT in hardened model
expected: prepareResume returns status: 'blocked' and resumable: false with blockingSideEffects populated
observed: prepareResume returns status: 'ready' and resumable: true; ignoring local unverified mutating call
patch: Inspect local ExecutionEngine.toolCheckpoints in prepareResume and merge unreconciled non-READ_ONLY calls into blockingSideEffects
post_fix_evidence: 5/5 tests pass in recoverySafetyDefects.test.ts; 62/62 core recovery and transport tests pass
limitations: Applies when ExecutionEngine is passed in HarnessResumeServiceOptions

invariant: Inv_TerminalExecutionMonotonicity: Restored checkpoint must be registered and durable on target worker
preconditions: Checkpoint bundle transferred and unpacked on remote worker via restoreOnTarget
sequence: 1. Source worker packages ExecutionCheckpoint into bundle 2. Target worker invokes restoreOnTarget 3. Files snapshot materialized to disk 4. Reconstructed ExecutionCheckpoint was never registered in CheckpointService 5. getCheckpoint returns undefined; handoffs and rollbacks fail
expected: checkpointService.getCheckpoint returns reconstructed checkpoint with metadata and side effects preserved
observed: checkpointService.getCheckpoint returned undefined; checkpoint lost after disk materialization
patch: Add registerCheckpoint method to CheckpointService and invoke await params.checkpointService.registerCheckpoint(checkpoint) in restoreOnTarget
post_fix_evidence: 5/5 tests pass in recoverySafetyDefects.test.ts; 14/14 checkpointTransport tests pass
limitations: Target filesystem must have write permissions for workspace directory

invariant: Inv_NoResumeWithUnknownOutcome: Unresolved side effects from imported checkpoint metadata must not be dropped
preconditions: Execution imported on remote worker from PortableCheckpointEnvelope containing unresolved mutating calls; local engine has no prior events
sequence: 1. Worker imports portable checkpoint envelope with unresolved mutating side effect 2. Checkpoint saved with portableEnvelope in metadata 3. Worker calls createPortableHandoff 4. Handoff only inspected engine toolCheckpoints and event checkpoints 5. Preserved unresolved side effect dropped; handoff marked resumable: true
expected: createPortableHandoff preserves unresolved side effects from checkpoint metadata and marks resumable: false
observed: createPortableHandoff dropped unresolved side effects from checkpoint metadata and marked resumable: true
patch: Resolve referenced ExecutionCheckpoint in createPortableHandoff and extract unresolvedSideEffects from metadata.portableEnvelope before building handoff
post_fix_evidence: 5/5 tests pass in recoverySafetyDefects.test.ts; 15/15 harnessResume tests pass
limitations: Metadata must conform to PortableCheckpointEnvelope schema

invariant: Inv_NoResumeWithUnknownOutcome: SequencedExecutionEvents with eventType must be recognized during recovery extraction
preconditions: Execution history contains SequencedExecutionEvents where eventType is populated instead of event.type
sequence: 1. SequencedExecutionEvents emitted with eventType: 'tool.started' 2. extractToolCheckpoints and engine.toolCheckpoints strictly checked event.type 3. Event check failed; 0 tool checkpoints extracted 4. Recovery logic believed zero tools were executed; unknown-outcome mutation missed
expected: extractToolCheckpoints extracts all tool checkpoints from events with eventType
observed: extractToolCheckpoints returned empty array [] missing in-flight mutating call
patch: Check (event as any).eventType ?? event.type across extractToolCheckpoints and executionEngine.toolCheckpoints
post_fix_evidence: 5/5 tests pass in recoverySafetyDefects.test.ts; 8/8 executionRecovery tests pass
limitations: Compatible with both legacy and sequenced event formats

invariant: Inv_TerminalExecutionMonotonicity: Terminal status 'failed' must be classified non-resumable
preconditions: Execution has terminal status 'failed' without active error recovery strategy
sequence: 1. Execution fails due to unrecoverable error 2. classifyPortableResumability checked status === 'completed' or 'cancelled' omitting 'failed' 3. classifyPortableResumability returned resumable: true 4. Downstream resumption logic attempted to resume failed execution without reset
expected: classifyPortableResumability returns resumable: false for status 'failed'
observed: classifyPortableResumability returned resumable: true for status 'failed'
patch: Add input.status === 'failed' to non-resumable terminal status check in classifyPortableResumability and handoffService
post_fix_evidence: 5/5 tests pass in recoverySafetyDefects.test.ts; 16/16 portableCheckpoint tests pass
limitations: Explicit recovery/retry workflows should fork or create new execution rather than resuming failed in-place
